title: ILS out in low clouds
blurb: SEA's runway 16R ILS is out while low clouds hang on; PHX's glideslope outage doesn't matter in clear skies.
description: NOTAMs take the runway 16R instrument landing system at SEA out of service while SEA is IFR (ceiling 700 ft, 4 miles in rain and mist) for the next 6 hours, then clears. The ILS outage is Low only in the IFR hours. PHX has a glideslope outage in clear weather: information only, no reason and no level.

assert.note: VFR after the TAF's FM group: the ILS outage no longer counts

assert.re: Notices.*instrument landing system \(ILS\) out of service
